The '''Oriolan sector''' was a part of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] that contained the [[Oriolanis system/Legends|Oriolanis]], [[Polomie system/Legends|Polomie]], and [[Werta system/Legends|Werta systems]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the celestial body [[Polomie]] and a [[Unidentified moon (Werta system)|moon]] in the Werta [[Star system/Legends|system]] both housed [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] installations that [[Battle of Polomie|were]] [[Assault on the Werta system moon|attacked]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Oriolanis]], on the other hand, was the site of an Imperial [[Imperial Military/Legends|military]] [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyard]].

==Description==
The Oriolan [[Sector/Legends|sector]] was situated in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. By [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], it bordered the [[Sombure sector/Legends|Sombure sector]] [[spinward]], the [[Iska sector/Legends|Iska]] and [[Masla sector/Legends|Masla sectors]] [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Rimward]], and the [[Halm sector/Legends|Halm sector]] and the [[Jidlor Marches/Legends|Jidlor Marches]] in the [[trailing]] direction. The sector also formed a part of the Mid Rim's [[Core Worlds/Legends|Coreward]] border with the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region's]]<ref name="Mid Rim" /> [[Har Worlds]] and [[Piryn Shar sector/Legends|Piryn Shar sectors]].<ref name="Expansion">{{SW|url=news/essential-atlas-extra-expansion-region|text=Essential Atlas Extra: Expansion Region}}</ref>

The [[Oriolanis system/Legends|Oriolanis]], [[Polomie system/Legends|Polomie]], and [[Werta system/Legends|Werta systems]] all lay within the Oriolan sector,<ref name="EAOC" /> and they contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Oriolanis]],<ref name="NEGWT">''[[The New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> the celestial body [[Polomie]],<ref name="TFUII" /> and a [[Unidentified moon (Werta system)|terrestrial moon]], respectively.<ref name="GaW" /> The [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Great Gran Run/Legends|Great Gran Run]] passed through the northern portion of the sector,<ref name="GGR" /> connecting it to the Halm sector's [[Halm system/Legends|Halm system]] and the [[Har system]] of the Har Worlds.<ref name="Expansion" />

==History==
{{Quote|I am pleased to report that the Cygnus Spaceworks Nemesis-class gunship exceeded all expectation during its first field test against the Rebel stronghold on Polomie.|Excerpt from Inspector-General Moff Rebu's report to the [[Imperial Department of Military Research/Legends|Imperial Department of Military Research]]|<ref name="TFUII" />}}
{{RPGseed}}
As part of the [[Western Reaches Operation]] in [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]], [[Imperial Military/Legends|forces]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] traveled Rimward along the section of the Great Gran Run<ref name="EGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> that passed through the Oriolan sector.<ref name="GGR" /> During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] maintained a [[Unidentified Rebel stronghold|stronghold]] on Polomie<ref name="TFUII" /> as well as a large [[Unidentified Rebel base (Werta system moon)|base]] on the Werta [[Star system/Legends|system]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]].<ref name="GaW" /> At some point by [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]],<ref name="Date">The [[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II (graphic novel)|comic adaptation]] of ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]'', and therefore the events of that [[Star Wars video games|video game]], is set in [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]].</ref> military forces [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanded]] by Imperial [[Inspector-General]] [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Rebu]] [[Battle of Polomie|decimated]] the Rebel forces at the Polomie [[Fortress/Legends|stronghold]],<ref name="TFUII" /> and the Empire also carried out a concerted [[Assault on the Werta system moon|assault]] on the Werta system base.<ref name="GaW" />
{{Endgame}}

Shortly before the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] of [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], Oriolanis was the site of a [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyard]] that produced [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers]] for the Empire.<ref name="EGTW" /> Later that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], the forces of the [[Firefist|extragalactic]] [[Nagai/Legends|Nagai]] and [[Tof/Legends|Tof]] [[Species/Legends|species]] traveled along the portion of the Great Gran Run<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> running through the Oriolan sector<ref name="GGR" /> while moving Coreward as part of the secondary movements of their [[Nagai–Tof War|separate invasions]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Oriolan sector was established in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which was written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]].<ref name="EAOC" /> In [[2012]], the sector was depicted on a map designed by [[Modi]] and published in the Online Companion feature "[https://www.starwars.com/news/essential-atlas-extra-sectors-of-the-mid-rim Essential Atlas Extra: Sectors of the Mid Rim]," which placed it in grid squares J-16 and K-16.<ref name="Mid Rim" />
